USGA Cookie Preference CenterYour Opt Out Preference Signal is HonoredYour Privacy ChoicesStrictly NecessaryFunctionalPerformanceMarketing and Advertising CookiesYour Privacy ChoicesWhen you visit this website, we store cookies on your browser to collect information. The information collected might relate to you, your preferences or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to and to provide a more personalized web experience. The cookies used are described in each tab. You can choose to opt-out of certain cookies. To disable certain cookies, use the on/off toggles on each tab and clicking the "Confirm My Choices" button at the bottom of this page. Opt-out of Sale or Targeted Advertising: You can choose to opt-out of sale or targeted advertising by disabling certain cookies with the on/off toggles on each tab and clicking the "Confirm My Choices" button at the bottom of this page. For Colorado, Delaware and New Jersey Residents: To exercise other data subject rights, including to opt-out of offline sale or sharing of your personal information, use the "Data Rights Request" link below and follow the prompts. Data Rights Request If you have an opt-out preference signal enabled on your browser or device, USGA will seek to honor this signal as a browser-level opt-out, and “Your Opt-Out Preference Signal is Honored” should appear. Clearing your cookies on your browser or device at any time may undo the cookie preferences saved here and reenable cookies through this website. To re-save your cookie preferences for this website after clearing your cookies, please return to this Cookie Preference Center and select your preferences. Please note that your preferences may not be saved if you are using a private mode in your web browser. For additional information about how the USGA collects, uses, and shares your information, and the choices that the USGA makes available to you, please read our USGA Privacy Policy. USGA Privacy PolicyStrictly NecessaryAlways ActiveThese cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.Functional Functional These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.Performance Performance These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.Marketing and Advertising Cookies Marketing and Advertising Cookies These cookies may be set through our website by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant advertisements on other sites. They do not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising. You will still see ads but they may be less relevant to you.
